content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the United States. Expedited shipping takes 2 business days. Shipping times are counted from the day an order leaves our warehouse.
title: Shipping

content: Returns are accepted within a 30-day window of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Start a return from your account page and include the original packing slip.
title: Returns

content: The lifetime warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship. It does not cover normal wear, misuse, or accidental damage.
title: Warranty

content: Trail boots run true to size. Use the size chart on the product page and measure your foot in the evening for the best fit.
title: Sizing

content: Track your order with the tracking number emailed after shipment. Enter that tracking number on the order tracking page to see the current status of your order.
title: Order tracking

content: Gift cards never expire and can be used online and in store. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash and cannot be reloaded.
title: Gift cards

content: Store pickup orders are ready in 2 hours during store hours. Bring your order confirmation and photo identification when you collect a store pickup order.
title: Store pickup

content: International shipping takes 7 to 14 business days. Customs duties and taxes for international shipping are paid by the customer on delivery.
title: International shipping

content: Exchanges are accepted within a 30-day window of delivery for the same item in a different size. An exchange ships at no extra shipping charge once the original item is received.
title: Exchanges

content: Report a damaged item within 14 days of delivery and include a photo of the damage. A replacement for a damaged item ships once the report is reviewed.
title: Damaged items

content: Reset your password with the forgot password link on the sign-in page. A password reset link is valid for 24 hours.
title: Account and password

content: Support hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Pacific. Email sent during support hours receives a reply within 1 business day.
title: Contact hours
